description: 《Hold My Hand》描寫一份在痛苦與恐懼中，仍然願意陪伴、守護與支持對方的深厚感情。歌中的主角看見心愛的人正承受傷害與內心的掙扎，希望對方能勇敢說出自己的需要，無須獨自面對困難。她承諾無論未來多麼艱難，都會緊握對方的手，陪伴他走過人生的低谷。歌曲亦鼓勵人們勇敢流淚、接納脆弱，並相信時間能逐漸撫平傷痛。反覆出現的「Hold My Hand」象徵信任、希望與永不放棄的支持。最終，《Hold My Hand》傳達的是愛、勇氣與心靈的治癒：即使生命充滿不確定與挑戰，只要願意敞開心扉、彼此扶持，便能在最黑暗的時刻找到希望，重新獲得前進的力量。

vocabulary.usage: 形容身體持續疼痛；常說 aching arms / feet / back。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: After carrying the heavy drum all afternoon, my arms were aching.
The train was aching at the station for ten minutes.
Our school will aching a new library next year.
Please aching the lights before the show begins.
optionExplanations: 搬了一下午沉重的鼓，手臂痠痛，aching 用來描述持續疼痛。
火車停靠應說 waiting 或 staying，aching 不能表示停留。
aching 不是「興建」的動詞，應說 build。
要打開燈應說 turn on，不能用 aching 當動詞。
vocabulary.explanation: 搬了一下午沉重的鼓，手臂痠痛，aching 用來描述持續疼痛。

vocabulary.usage: 常用於安慰、擁抱或保護；pull + 人 + close。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The pilot pulled the airport close before the plane landed.
The photographer pulled the sunshine close to take a brighter photo.
When her brother came home after a year, she pulled him close and hugged him.
The museum pulled the history close at nine o’clock.
optionExplanations: 機師不能把整座機場拉近；要說 flew toward the airport。
陽光不能像人一樣被拉近；可以說 moved into the sunlight。
久別重逢時把弟弟拉近擁抱，符合片語用法。
這裡想表達開館，應說 opened，不能用 pull someone close。
vocabulary.explanation: 久別重逢時把弟弟拉近擁抱，符合片語用法。

vocabulary.meaning: 放手；不再抓住；也可指放下情緒
vocabulary.usage: 常用 let go of + 名詞，例如 let go of the rope / fear。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The guide told us to let go the map of the city.
When the boat reached the dock, Noah let go of the rope.
After the concert, Mia let go at the piano for three hours.
Our coach let go to the team before the big game.
optionExplanations: 若要說放開地圖，應說 let go of the map，少了 of。
船靠岸時鬆開繩子，let go of 用法正確。
彈鋼琴要用 played，let go at 不表示演奏。
對球隊講話應說 spoke to，let go to 並無此意。
vocabulary.explanation: 船靠岸時鬆開繩子，let go of 用法正確。

vocabulary.usage: raise 是及物動詞；raise your head 是把頭往上抬。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The city raised its head into a new subway line.
At the bank, I raised my head for fifty dollars from the machine.
The singer raised her head the song on the radio.
The librarian raised her head to see who had entered the quiet room.
optionExplanations: 興建捷運線應說 built，不能用 raise its head into。
從提款機領錢應說 withdrew，不能用 raise my head for。
播放歌曲應說 played，raise her head 不能直接接歌曲當受詞。
聽到有人進圖書館便抬頭查看，意思自然正確。
vocabulary.explanation: 聽到有人進圖書館便抬頭查看，意思自然正確。

vocabulary.usage: 用於需要時間改善、適應或發展的情況。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: We gave it time to the ticket office at noon.
The dancer gave it time in a box to send to her friend.
You may feel nervous at your new job, but give it time.
Our teacher gave it time the students for the exam.
optionExplanations: 買票應說 went to the ticket office；give it time 不是「前往」。
時間不是能裝箱寄送的物品；此處應說 sent a gift。
新工作需要適應，勸對方別急很自然。
若指給學生更多考試時間，應說 gave the students more time。
vocabulary.explanation: 新工作需要適應，勸對方別急很自然。

vocabulary.usage: 常指看不見明顯的問題或事實；be blind to + 名詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The mayor was blind to the broken streetlights until people complained.
The painter was blind to a brush to finish the picture.
My cousin is blind to play the violin every Thursday.
The hotel is blind to the beach by a short bus ride.
optionExplanations: 市長先前沒有注意到壞掉的路燈，blind to 表忽略問題。
畫畫需用 used a brush，blind to 不能表示使用工具。
要說學小提琴應用 learning to play，blind to 不能接原形動詞。
要說旅館離海灘很近，可用 close to，blind to 不是距離。
vocabulary.explanation: 市長先前沒有注意到壞掉的路燈，blind to 表忽略問題。

vocabulary.usage: 可以 whisper to someone 或 whisper a secret；不是大聲喊叫。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The actor whispered so loudly that people outside the stadium heard him.
At the surprise party, Ella whispered the plan to her cousin.
The mechanic whispered the old engine with a new part.
Our class whispered a race across the school field.
optionExplanations: whisper 指小聲說話，吼到場外都聽見與詞義衝突。
驚喜派對怕被發現，小聲告知計畫符合 whisper。
修引擎應說 repaired，whisper 不是「修理」。
舉辦比賽應說 held a race；whisper 不能表示舉辦。
vocabulary.explanation: 驚喜派對怕被發現，小聲告知計畫符合 whisper。

vocabulary.meaning: 對某人放棄希望、不再支持
vocabulary.usage: give up on + 人；不同於 give up + 活動（停止做某事）。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: My aunt gave up on the bus at 8:30 and arrived downtown.
The artist gave up on the wall a bright blue color.
I gave up on to my grandmother yesterday.
The science team did not give up on Leo, even after his robot failed twice.
optionExplanations: 若指搭公車應說 got on the bus，give up on 不是上車。
幫牆上色應說 painted the wall，give up on 不能表示塗色。
give up on 後需接名詞或 V-ing，不能接 to my grandmother 表示拜訪。
即使機器人失敗兩次，隊友仍不放棄 Leo，搭配正確。
vocabulary.explanation: 即使機器人失敗兩次，隊友仍不放棄 Leo，搭配正確。

vocabulary.meaning: 在某人需要時陪伴、支持他
vocabulary.usage: 指情感或實際支持，不只是地點上的「在那裡」。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: This phone was there for the battery for two hours.
When I lost the chess final, my friends were there for me.
The stage was there for a purple song last night.
The flight was there for Tokyo at seven o’clock.
optionExplanations: 要說電池續航，應說 the battery lasted two hours。
西洋棋決賽失利時朋友陪伴支持，符合 be there for someone。
舞台不能為歌曲提供情感支持；可說 the band performed a song。
班機飛往東京應說 left for Tokyo，be there for 不表示出發。
vocabulary.explanation: 西洋棋決賽失利時朋友陪伴支持，符合 be there for someone。

vocabulary.usage: promise + 人 + that 子句，或 promise to + 原形動詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The tour guide promised us that we would get back before sunset.
The reporter promised the camera across the river.
My brother promised to the library at five and borrowed a book.
The runner promised a mountain in just ten minutes.
optionExplanations: 導遊承諾日落前回來，promise + 人 + that 子句正確。
要說把攝影機帶過河應說 carried，promise 不是「搬運」。
若指前往圖書館應說 went to；promise to 後需要動詞原形。
跑者爬上山應說 climbed a mountain，promise 並非攀爬。
vocabulary.explanation: 導遊承諾日落前回來，promise + 人 + that 子句正確。

audioAlignment.reviewStatus: Conservative automatic line alignment. Unmatched/overlapping background lines remain bilingual without guessed timestamps; not a full manual timing certification.

structure.title: 句型研習
structure.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.word: 祈使句：動詞原形 + 受詞
questions.meaning: 請對方做一個動作。
questions.usage: 用直接但友善的方式提出請求；主詞 you 通常省略。
questions.prompt: 在擁擠的夜市，孩子怕跟媽媽走散，哪句請求最合適？
options: Hold my ticket so you can eat it.
Holding my hand is a type of train.
Hold my hand so we can stay together.
My hand holds the night market open.
optionExplanations: C 拿票吃掉與避免走散無關。
D 把牽手誤說成交通工具。
A 明確請對方牽手以免走散。
B 把手說成能開啟夜市，不合語意。
questions.explanation: A 明確請對方牽手以免走散。

questions.word: will + be + 形容詞（未來狀態）
questions.meaning: 預測或安慰未來的情況。
questions.usage: 用 will be 加形容詞，表達對未來狀態的看法。
questions.prompt: 小型演出開始前，音響剛修好，主持人要安撫大家，哪句最合適？
options: The music will be a cold sandwich.
Everything will be okay now that the sound works.
optionExplanations: C 將音樂比作三明治，情境不符。
B 音響已恢復，對接下來的演出給予合理安慰。
A 只談昨天的怪異比喻，不能安慰現場。
D 缺少 be，句子不合文法。
questions.explanation: B 音響已恢復，對接下來的演出給予合理安慰。

questions.word: hear from + 來源
questions.meaning: 從某個來源聽到消息。
questions.usage: hear from 後接傳遞消息的人或來源，不是單純「聽見某聲音」。
questions.prompt: 旅遊團的導遊收到博物館通知改了開放時間，該怎樣說？
options: The museum heard from a blue umbrella.
I heard from my map with a spoon.
I heard from the museum that it opens at ten.
I heard from ten o'clock the museum.
optionExplanations: C 藍雨傘沒有合理的通知功能。
D 地圖和湯匙的關係無法表達收到消息。
A 正確交代消息來自博物館。
B 把時間當成訊息來源，搭配不自然。
questions.explanation: A 正確交代消息來自博物館。

questions.word: heard + that + 子句（轉述訊息）
questions.meaning: 轉述自己聽到的一件事。
questions.usage: that 後面接完整子句；省略 that 也可能自然，但本歌確實有 that。
questions.prompt: 天文館的導覽員從同事得知今晚會有流星雨，哪句適合轉述？
options: I heard that tonight may bring many shooting stars.
I heard the stars to shine yesterday.
I heard that the door is a planet because it is blue.
I heard that the telescope with a red.
optionExplanations: A 是有完整內容的消息轉述。
C 不能用 heard + 受詞 + to 動詞來表達這個消息。
D 把門當行星的理由不成立。
B that 後的句子缺少必要動詞。
questions.cue: I heard from the heavens that clouds have been grey
questions.explanation: A 是有完整內容的消息轉述。

questions.word: 現在完成式：have/has been + 形容詞
questions.meaning: 描述從過去延續到目前的狀態。
questions.usage: have been 搭配形容詞，尤其適合描述一段時間以來的變化或感受。
questions.prompt: 一座小島這幾天一直下雨，氣象員要描述天空，哪句最自然？
options: The clouds have dark all week.
The clouds have been dance on the sea.
The clouds were been dark tomorrow.
The clouds have been dark all week.
optionExplanations: B 缺少 been，文法不完整。
C been 後不能直接這樣接動詞原形。
D were been 和 tomorrow 的時間搭配錯誤。
A 現在完成式描述一整週持續陰暗。
questions.explanation: A 現在完成式描述一整週持續陰暗。

questions.word: pull + 受詞 + 形容詞（結果位置）
questions.meaning: 把某人或某物拉到更靠近的位置。
questions.usage: close 是動作後的結果狀態；可用於安全、擁抱或物件的移動。
questions.prompt: 舞台表演時，攝影師想把椅子拉近燈光，哪句合適？
options: Pull the chair close to the light for the photo.
Please pull the light a new song.
The chair pulled the camera happy.
Pull close the photo into the chair yesterday.
optionExplanations: A 讓椅子靠近燈光，位置變化明確。
D 拉動燈光不能創造一首新歌。
C happy 不能表示相機被拉動的結果位置。
B 語序不自然且動作對象混亂。
questions.explanation: A 讓椅子靠近燈光，位置變化明確。

questions.word: wrap + 受詞 + in + 包覆物
questions.meaning: 用某物把對象包起來或圍住。
questions.usage: 常說 wrap someone in a blanket，也可以用於擁抱的比喻。
questions.prompt: 露營時氣溫突然下降，哪句最適合照顧朋友？
options: Wrap your friend in a warm blanket.
Wrap the fire in a glass of milk.
Wrap in your friend a blanket warm.
Wrap the cold night in our tent.
optionExplanations: B 用暖毯把朋友包住，搭配自然。
C 用牛奶包火，語意不合理。
D 動詞後的受詞與介系詞位置錯亂。
A 夜晚不是可被帳篷包裹的物品。
questions.cue: wrap me in your aching arms
questions.explanation: B 用暖毯把朋友包住，搭配自然。

questions.word: see + that + 完整子句
questions.meaning: 表達自己看出或了解到某個情況。
questions.usage: see that 可以表示「我看得出來」，that 後用完整子句。
questions.prompt: 老師看見學生練習後進步很大，哪句最自然？
options: I see that your drawing better now.
I see that your drawing is much better now.
I see your progress to be tomorrow yesterday.
I see that to the kitchen is blue.
optionExplanations: B 子句缺少 be 動詞。
A 明確指出觀察到的進步。
D 時態和句子結構混亂。
C that 後面不是完整且合理的陳述。
questions.explanation: A 明確指出觀察到的進步。

questions.word: Why did + 主詞 + take so long + to-V？
questions.meaning: 詢問為何花了這麼長時間才做某事。
questions.usage: why'd 是 why did 的口語縮寫；後面用動詞原形 take。
questions.prompt: 朋友花了兩小時才找到餐廳，大家想問原因，哪句最自然？
options: Why did the café take your friend as a map?
Why you did take so long finding the café?
Why did you take so long to find the café?
Why did you took so long to find the café?
optionExplanations: D 把餐廳說成拿朋友當地圖，語意不合理。
C 問句助動詞位置不對。
B 詢問找餐廳花太久的原因，句型正確。
A did 後應用 take 原形，不能用 took。
questions.explanation: B 詢問找餐廳花太久的原因，句型正確。

questions.word: don't need to + 動詞原形
questions.meaning: 表示某個動作沒有必要。
questions.usage: 這是「不必做」，不等於「被禁止做」。
questions.prompt: 導覽員已經看過參觀者的票，哪句話自然又有禮貌？
options: You don't need to eat the museum twice.
You don't need to your ticket again.
You don't need to show your ticket again; I checked it.
You don't need showing your ticket again.
optionExplanations: D 吃博物館不合語意。
C to 後缺少動詞。
A 已驗票，所以不必再出示。
B need 後接 to-V，此處形式錯誤。
questions.cue: You don't need to show me again
questions.explanation: A 已驗票，所以不必再出示。

questions.word: if + 主詞 + decide to（省略已知動作）
questions.meaning: 如果最後決定這麼做。
questions.usage: to 後省略前面提過的動作；只能在上下文清楚時省略。
questions.prompt: 朋友邀請你參加陶藝班，你還在考慮，哪組對話自然？
options: “Is it raining?” “If decide to is the rain.”
“Will you join us?” “If I decide to, I'll tell you.”
“What time is it?” “If I decide to, seven.”
“Where is the cup?” “If I decide to the shelf.”
optionExplanations: D 缺主詞且整句不通順。
A 參加課程已在前文提過，可省略 join。
B 沒有前文動作供 to 承接。
C to 後的地點無法替代動詞。
questions.cue: But if you decide to, I'll ride in this life with you

pattern.text: if you decide to [省略前文動作]

questions.explanation: A 參加課程已在前文提過，可省略 join。

questions.word: if + 現在式，will + 動詞（第一類條件）
questions.meaning: 某條件成立時，未來會採取某行動。
questions.usage: 真實可能的未來條件：if 子句用現在式，主句可用 will。
questions.prompt: 朋友在科學展需要幫忙，你答應有空就去，哪句最自然？
options: If I will have time, I help you yesterday.
If I have time, I'll help you set up the robot.
If time me, I will the robot.
If I have time, I'll be a purple floor.
optionExplanations: B if 子句和 yesterday 的時態混亂。
A if 用現在式，後句以 will 表示承諾。
D 缺少主詞和動詞，句子不完整。
C 變成紫色地板不是合理的協助。
questions.cue: if you decide to, I'll ride in this life with you
questions.explanation: A if 用現在式，後句以 will 表示承諾。

questions.word: won't + 動詞 + till + 名詞時間
questions.meaning: 直到某個終點都不做某事。
questions.usage: till / 'til 是 until 的常見形式；歌詞中的縮寫需要標示語域。
questions.prompt: 朋友在過山車上很緊張，工作人員提醒扶好安全扶手，哪句承諾自然？
options: I won't my seat until the chair sings.
I won't leaves my seat until the ride ends.
I won't leave my seat until yesterday.
I won't leave my seat until the ride ends.
optionExplanations: D won't 後缺少動詞，而且椅子唱歌不合情境。
B won't 後不能用 leaves。
C until yesterday 與未來承諾衝突。
A 表示旅程結束前不離座，時序合理。
questions.cue: I won't let go 'til the end
questions.explanation: A 表示旅程結束前不離座，時序合理。

questions.word: 強調式否定命令：Don't you + 動詞原形
questions.meaning: 帶強烈提醒或情緒的否定命令。
questions.usage: 比一般 Don't + V 更有感情；語氣可能親密，也可能較強硬。
questions.prompt: 野外健行時領隊提醒同伴別踩進危險區域，哪句合適？
options: Don't you stepping beyond that line!
Don't you steps beyond that line!
Don't you step beyond that line!
Don't you a line beyond the mountain.
optionExplanations: C 不能接 stepping 表示這種命令。
B Don't you 後需用動詞原形 step。
A 強烈提醒不可越過界線，句型正確。
D 缺少合適動詞，無法構成命令句。
questions.cue: don't you let go of my hand
questions.explanation: A 強烈提醒不可越過界線，句型正確。

questions.word: can + 動詞原形（允許或能力）
questions.meaning: 表示可以做某件事。
questions.usage: can 依情境可指能力或允許；後接原形動詞。
questions.prompt: 在美術室，學生問可否坐著畫畫，老師該怎樣回答？
options: You can sitting here and paint.
You can sit here and paint.
You can to sit here and paint.
You can the painting in a chair.
optionExplanations: B can 後不能直接用 sitting。
A 可以坐在這裡畫畫，can 後接原形。
C can 後不加 to。
D can 後缺少動詞。
questions.cue: You can cry every last tear
questions.explanation: A 可以坐在這裡畫畫，can 後接原形。

questions.word: 每一個：every last + 單數名詞
questions.meaning: 強調全部、一個也不漏。
questions.usage: 比 every 更強調數量完整，常見於強調或誇張語境。
questions.prompt: 考古隊整理完箱子，要強調一件文物也沒漏，哪句最合適？
options: We counted every last coins in the box.
Every last is a type of old coin.
We counted every last weather yesterday.
We counted every last coin in the box.
optionExplanations: B every last 後應用單數名詞 coin。
C 把片語當作物品名稱。
D weather 不能在此作可數的一個個物件。
A 強調所有硬幣都已點算。
questions.explanation: A 強調所有硬幣都已點算。

questions.word: until + 現在式（表示未來截止點）
questions.meaning: 在某件事發生之前一直保持目前做法。
questions.usage: 未來時間子句常用現在式，不用 will；與 until + 名詞的用法不同。
questions.prompt: 烘焙師要等蛋糕冷卻才裝飾，哪句正確？
options: I won't add the cream until the cake will cool.
I won't add the cream because the oven is a singer.
I won't add the cream until the cake cools.
I won't add the cream until cake cooling.
optionExplanations: B 時間子句一般不用 will 表達這種未來。
D 烤箱是歌手與裝飾蛋糕無關。
A until 後用現在式表未來的時間點。
C 缺主詞與完整的謂語。
questions.explanation: A until 後用現在式表未來的時間點。

questions.word: promise + 人 +（承諾內容）
questions.meaning: 請對方給自己一個承諾。
questions.usage: promise me 是直接請求；歌詞後面另接祈使句，不要誤標為 promise me + that。
questions.prompt: 登山前，媽媽要孩子答應會戴好安全帽，哪句最自然？
options: Promise me you'll wear your helmet.
Promise me the mountain is a spoon.
optionExplanations: A promise me 後交代答應的內容，符合語意。
D 山是湯匙不可能是合理承諾。
B to 後缺少動詞，且內容不完整。
C 詞序和動作關係不合理。
questions.cue: Promise me, just hold my hand
questions.explanation: A promise me 後交代答應的內容，符合語意。

questions.word: promise +（that）完整子句
questions.meaning: 答應某件事將會發生或自己會做到。
questions.usage: 可以直接接子句；歌詞省略 that，不能因此說它出現了另一個新語法。
questions.prompt: 兩位同學約好要保護展覽用的模型，哪句自然？
options: Promise you'll keep the model safe.
Promise the model safe will you.
Promise keep that you'll the model.
optionExplanations: A 省略 that 的承諾子句仍完整自然。
D 混亂的倒裝使承諾內容不清。
C promise 和 that 子句語序錯亂。
B you'll 後缺少主要動詞。
questions.cue: Promise you'll just hold my hand
questions.explanation: A 省略 that 的承諾子句仍完整自然。

questions.word: look into + 名詞（朝內看／注視）
questions.meaning: 把目光投向某處裡面或仔細注視。
questions.usage: 此歌是注視眼睛；look into 也可表示調查，但不要把另一義項當新抽取結構。
questions.prompt: 潛水員從船上看向透明的水中，哪句最自然？
options: Look the clear water into your eyes for fish.
Look into to the clear water.
Look into the ticket so the clock can swim.
Look into the clear water and you may see fish.
optionExplanations: D 介系詞位置錯誤，意思混亂。
C into 後不應再加 to。
B 票和游泳的時鐘沒有合理關係。
A 看向水中，位置與意義都合理。
questions.explanation: A 看向水中，位置與意義都合理。

questions.word: 關係子句：名詞 + that's + 位置片語
questions.meaning: 用關係子句指明是哪一件事物。
questions.usage: 歌詞的 that's = that is，補充指向「你內心的恐懼」。
questions.prompt: 工作坊有好幾箱道具，要指出舞台旁的那個箱子，哪句自然？
options: The box that's beside the stage is ours.
The box that beside the stage is ours.
The box that's beside the stage belong ours.
The box that's beside the stage are ours.
optionExplanations: A that's = that is，清楚限定箱子位置。
C 這裡缺少 be 動詞。
D belong 缺第三人稱 -s 以及 to。
B 單數 box 應搭配 is 而不是 are。
questions.cue: That fear that's inside you will lift
questions.explanation: A that's = that is，清楚限定箱子位置。

questions.word: give it time（固定表達）
questions.meaning: 讓一個過程慢慢發展，不要急於求成。
questions.usage: 新環境、學習或改變需要時間時使用；這是歌中原有的完整表達。
questions.prompt: 朋友剛開始學陶藝，作品還不漂亮，你應怎樣鼓勵？
options: Give it time a new blue bicycle.
The clay gives it time to become a train station.
Give it time into the oven at 180 degrees.
Your bowls will improve. Give it time.
optionExplanations: C 把 time 當作能給腳踏車的物品。
D 陶土變成火車站不合理。
B 把 time 當成可放進烤箱的物品。
A 鼓勵慢慢學習，符合慣用語。
questions.explanation: A 鼓勵慢慢學習，符合慣用語。

questions.word: everything + 省略關係代名詞的子句
questions.meaning: 用子句補充說明「所有哪些事」。
questions.usage: 歌詞確實省略關係代名詞 that；不是另行創造無 that 句型。
questions.prompt: 海洋研究員要檢查所有記錄過的魚，哪句自然？
options: We checked everything we wrote down yesterday.
We checked everything where write down yesterday.
We checked everything we wrote yesterday it.
optionExplanations: A everything 後直接接修飾它的子句，that 可省略。
C where 和動詞形式都不符合此關係子句。
B 多出 it，重複擔任受詞。
D 缺正常的主詞、動詞組織。
questions.cue: I can see everything you're blind to now
questions.explanation: A everything 後直接接修飾它的子句，that 可省略。

questions.word: be blind to + 名詞
questions.meaning: 沒有察覺某事物或問題。
questions.usage: 這裡是比喻性的「看不見、沒注意到」，不是指視覺障礙。
questions.prompt: 城市公園的設計師沒注意到輪椅使用者無法進門，哪句自然？
options: The designer was blind to the problem until visitors told her.
The designer was blind in a blue ticket.
The designer was blind to build the gate.
The designer was blind to tomorrow yesterday.
optionExplanations: A 指之前沒有察覺入口障礙，意義準確。
C 藍色票券沒有表示忽略問題的意思。
B be blind to 後不能直接接動詞原形。
D 時間詞混用且缺具體被忽略的事情。
questions.explanation: A 指之前沒有察覺入口障礙，意義準確。

questions.word: 未來被動：will be + 過去分詞
questions.meaning: 某事將在未來受到處理或回應。
questions.usage: 強調承受動作的對象；不一定交代執行者。
questions.prompt: 圖書館已收到讀者的問題，哪句公告文法正確？
options: Your questions are will answered tomorrow.
Your questions will be answer tomorrow.
Your questions will be answered tomorrow.
optionExplanations: B 缺少 be。
D 助動詞和 be 動詞順序錯誤。
C answered 應為過去分詞，不是原形 answer。
A will be answered 是正確的未來被動結構。
questions.explanation: A will be answered 是正確的未來被動結構。

questions.word: let + 受詞 + 原形動詞
questions.meaning: 讓某人進行某個動作。
questions.usage: let 後先接受詞，再接原形動詞，不加 to；不將此改成 let + -ing。
questions.prompt: 舞台導演想讓年輕演員先講，哪句合適？
options: Let the new actor speaks first.
Let the new actor speak first.
Let the new actor to speak first.
Let speaking the new actor first.
optionExplanations: D 不能用 speaks。
A let 後接人再接 speak 原形。
B 不需要 to。
C 把動名詞放錯位置。
questions.explanation: A let 後接人再接 speak 原形。

questions.word: give up on + 受詞
questions.meaning: 不要對某人（包括自己）失去信心。
questions.usage: give up on 的 on 不可省略；與只表示停止活動的 give up 不完全一樣。
questions.prompt: 機器人比賽中，隊友失敗兩次，你會怎樣鼓勵他？
options: Don't you giving up on yourself yesterday.
Don't give up on yourself; your next idea may work.
Don't give up yourself on the table.
Don't give up on to your robot.
optionExplanations: D Don't you 後需要動詞原形，且 yesterday 不合。
A 表示仍應相信自己能改進。
B 把 yourself 當成可放桌上的物品。
C on 後不能再接 to + 名詞。
questions.cue: don't you give up on yourself
questions.explanation: A 表示仍應相信自己能改進。

questions.word: 現在完成式：have/has + 過去分詞
questions.meaning: 講述至今已有的經歷。
questions.usage: 現在完成式可用於談過去發生、但與現在談話相關的經驗。
questions.prompt: 電影社聊天時，有人想分享自己以前聽過的故事，哪句自然？
options: I have hearing that story before.
I has heard that story before.
optionExplanations: C have 後不能直接用 hearing 組成此現在完成式。
B 缺少 heard 的正確形式。
A have heard 使用過去分詞，談曾有的經驗。
D I 應搭配 have，不是 has。
questions.explanation: A have heard 使用過去分詞，談曾有的經驗。

questions.word: reported speech：過去轉述中的 would
questions.meaning: 從過去的角度轉述當時對未來的看法。
questions.usage: 歌詞以 would 表達過去所說的未來；不是假設語氣的新擴充。
questions.prompt: 老師回想多年前教練的鼓勵，哪句自然？
options: My coach told me I would a blue swimming pool.
My coach told me I would to become a swimmer.
My coach told me I will became a swimmer yesterday.
My coach told me I would become a good swimmer.
optionExplanations: D would 後缺少原形動詞。
C would 後不用 to。
B will became 的動詞形式錯誤。
A would become 表示教練當時相信我未來能成為游泳好手。
questions.cue: That I would be happy again
questions.explanation: A would become 表示教練當時相信我未來能成為游泳好手。

questions.word: I'll be + 地點／狀態（承諾自己會在）
questions.meaning: 向對方保證自己會在某處。
questions.usage: be + 地點副詞表未來的位置；right 加強「就在這裡」的語氣。
questions.prompt: 孩子進美術館尋找老師，老師要保證會在入口等，哪句自然？
options: I'll right here be the door at tomorrow.
I'll be right here by the door if you need me.
I'll be right here to the painting is blue.
optionExplanations: D be 的位置及介系詞都不正確。
A 清楚保證將在入口附近等候。
B 未來承諾與 yesterday 衝突。
C 後半句混亂，無法表示位置。
questions.explanation: A 清楚保證將在入口附近等候。

advanced.title: 進階字彙
advanced.note: 依提供的核對版材料編排；保留原有教學範圍。

questions.word: the heavens
questions.meaning: 天際；天空；（宗教語境中的）天堂
questions.usage: 較有文學色彩，談廣闊天空或天堂時使用。日常談天氣通常說 the sky。
options: The shop sold three heavens near the school.
We caught the heavens at the station at noon.
The stars shone in the heavens above the town.
The chef put the heavens in a pan with oil.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：the heavens 不是能按件出售的商品。
錯誤：不能用 catch the heavens 表示搭車。
正確：較富文學色彩地描述星星在天空中發亮。
錯誤：天空或天堂不是能放進鍋裡煎的食材。
questions.explanation: 正確：較富文學色彩地描述星星在天空中發亮。

questions.word: wrap someone in
questions.meaning: 用……包住某人；將某人裹在……裡
questions.usage: 天冷時用毯子、外套等包住一個人；也可在文學中描寫擁抱。
questions.prompt: 哪一句正確使用「wrap someone in」？
options: The baker wrapped the rain in a paper bag.
Dad wrapped the baby in a soft blue blanket.
The nurse wrapped the clock in a long nap.
The guide wrapped the map in a loud song.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：雨水不能像小物品一樣被裝進紙袋裡包好。
正確：用柔軟的毯子把寶寶包裹起來，搭配自然。
錯誤：nap 是小睡，不能當作包覆物包住時鐘。
錯誤：歌曲不能像布料一樣包住地圖；如果是放音樂，應用 played。
questions.explanation: 正確：用柔軟的毯子把寶寶包裹起來，搭配自然。

questions.word: bleed
questions.meaning: 流血；（比喻）失去血液般持續流失
questions.usage: 描述受傷流血，也可在正式語境比喻金錢或資源持續流失。
options: The train began to bleed beside the bridge.
His finger began to bleed after he cut it.
Her alarm began to bleed at seven this morning today.
My sandwich began to bleed in the lunchbox.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：火車停在橋旁不能描述為流血。
正確：手指割傷後開始流血，是 bleed 的常見字面用法。
錯誤：鬧鐘響起應用 ring，不能用 bleed。
錯誤：普通三明治不會流血；若流出醬汁可說 leak。
questions.explanation: 正確：手指割傷後開始流血，是 bleed 的常見字面用法。

questions.word: every last
questions.meaning: 每一個，連最後一個也不漏；全部
questions.usage: 加強語氣，表示連最小或最後的部分都包含在內；常見 every last one / drop / piece。
options: I bought every last at the toy shop yesterday.
The singer put every last under the piano.
My shoes were every last because they were red.
We checked every last box before we left.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：every last 後需有要強調的名詞，不能獨自當商品。
錯誤：沒有說明每一個什麼，不能當作物品放在鋼琴下。
錯誤：every last 不是描述鞋子顏色的形容詞。
正確：離開前把每一個箱子都檢查過，強調毫無遺漏。
questions.explanation: 正確：離開前把每一個箱子都檢查過，強調毫無遺漏。

questions.word: wishful
questions.meaning: 充滿願望的；一廂情願的
questions.usage: 常見 wishful thinking，表示只因為希望如此就以為會成真；歌詞的 wishful eyes 則偏詩意。
options: The bus was wishful at the corner of the road.
I wishful my bike to school every morning.
He made no plan; his hope was just wishful thinking.
She carried a wishful in her school bag before the test.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：公車停靠路口不會稱作 wishful。
錯誤：wishful 不是表示騎腳踏車的動詞。
正確：只抱希望卻沒有計畫，符合 wishful thinking「一廂情願的想法」。
錯誤：wishful 是形容詞，不是能放進書包的物品。
questions.explanation: 正確：只抱希望卻沒有計畫，符合 wishful thinking「一廂情願的想法」。

questions.word: lift
questions.meaning: （霧、陰影、壞情緒等）逐漸消散；解除
questions.usage: 除了「抬起」，還能說 fog / fear / sadness lifts，指不良狀態慢慢消退。
options: The fog finally lifted, and we could see the lake.
The little shop lifted its closing time into a bright bicycle.
The little boy lifted his sandwich into Tuesday.
The dog lifted the homework by feeling hungry.
optionExplanations: 正確：霧終於消散，視野變清楚；是 lift 的延伸用法。
錯誤：營業時間不能被「抬進腳踏車」；語意不通。
錯誤：into Tuesday 不是可被抬起、搬進去的地點；語意不自然。
錯誤：肚子餓不能用 lift 表示完成作業。
questions.explanation: 正確：霧終於消散，視野變清楚；是 lift 的延伸用法。

questions.word: prayer
questions.meaning: 祈禱；祈禱的話語
questions.usage: 談宗教、信仰或對他人的祝福時使用；常見 say a prayer、answer a prayer。
options: She said a quiet prayer for her sick friend.
The teacher used a prayer to cut the paper.
We wore warm prayers when the snow began.
The driver filled the empty tank with three long prayers.
optionExplanations: 正確：為生病的朋友輕聲祈禱；say a prayer 用法自然。
錯誤：祈禱不是剪紙工具，應用 scissors。
錯誤：祈禱不是能穿在身上的禦寒衣物。
錯誤：祈禱不是汽車油箱的燃料。
questions.explanation: 正確：為生病的朋友輕聲祈禱；say a prayer 用法自然。

questions.word: imperfect
questions.meaning: 不完美的；有缺點的
questions.usage: 談作品、計畫或人不完美但仍有價值時使用；原歌詞中的 imperfect pain 是特別的詩意搭配。
options: The small dog bought an imperfect from the local shop yesterday.
We drove imperfect to the beach after school.
He imperfect the windows before the storm came.
The drawing was imperfect, but I still liked it.
optionExplanations: 錯誤：imperfect 不是可數的商品名稱。
錯誤：imperfect 不能當成表示駕車方式的副詞。
錯誤：imperfect 是形容詞，不是表示關窗的動詞。
正確：畫作雖不完美，仍令人喜歡；語意自然。
questions.explanation: 正確：畫作雖不完美，仍令人喜歡；語意自然。
